id.description: URL-safe id, used in ?machines=<id>, data-machines and data-machines-only.

rotation.description: How and which designs take turns. utc-day is floor(UTC days since the epoch) modulo the number of rotating ids. interval is floor(now / intervalSeconds) modulo length. ?machines=<id> or ?machines=<n> overrides either rule.

ids.description: Ids of the variants that rotate, in order. Omit to rotate every variant. Variants not listed stay in the file for later.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds per slot when mode is interval. Required for interval, unused for utc-day. Must be above 0.

mode.description: utc-day: one design per UTC day. interval: one design per intervalSeconds.

headline.description: The section h2 while this design shows. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

note.description: Why this variant exists, for reviewers. Not rendered.

subhead.description: The paragraph under the h2 while this design shows. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

description: data/machines.json: the four designs of the home page's How it works section (the orders section), which of them rotate, and how. Every rotating variant is rendered into the static HTML and layouts/_partials/machines-rotation-head.html shows one at page load; the default is what no-JS visitors get. See docs/machines-variants.md.

default.description: Id of the variant no-JS visitors see. Must be one of the rotating ids (the build fails otherwise).

variants.description: Every variant. Only those listed in rotation.ids are shown; omit ids to rotate every variant.

title: Home page machines section variants
